about: Argon2id (version 0x13, 32 bytes out) as both halves of the app's password stretching must give it: pointycastle's on a phone and a computer (test/argon2_test.dart) and @noble/hashes' in a browser (tool/web/build-argon2.mjs checks web/argon2id.js against these, and tool/web/e2e.mjs asks the page itself). password is text, read as UTF-8; salt and key are hex; m is KiB, t passes, p lanes.
